overview: This paper proposes QuantSparse, a unified compression framework for Video Diffusion Transformers that integrates Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) and Attention Sparsification, featuring Multi-Scale Salient Attention Distillation (MSAD) to mitigate quantization-induced attention shifts and Second-Order Sparse Attention Reparameterization (SSAR) to recover sparsity-induced information loss via temporal stability.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Handles parsing and inheritance of experiment configurations, including bit-width settings, attention density, distillation hyperparameters, and cache intervals.

modules.name: Calibration Data Pipeline
modules.description: Manages the generation and loading of calibration data for PTQ, specifically handling latent noise sampling and data preprocessing required for video generation models.

modules.name: Model Quantizer
modules.description: Implements channel-wise weight quantization and dynamic token-wise activation quantization, including the rotation-based matrix transformation and scale/zero-point optimization.

modules.name: Sparse Attention Mask Generator
modules.description: Generates static spatial-temporal sparsity patterns (e.g., SVG-based masks) to prune negligible attention scores, transforming the quadratic attention complexity to near-linear.

modules.name: Sparse Attention Kernel
modules.description: Implements the forward pass for sparse attention computation using the generated masks and quantized Q/K/V tensors.

modules.name: MSAD - Saliency Evaluator
modules.description: Computes token saliency scores based on the aggregated attention mass received by each token to identify the heavy-tailed distribution of salient tokens.

modules.name: MSAD - Global Distillation
modules.description: Implements global guidance by downsampleing Q and K via average pooling to compute a low-resolution distillation loss that captures coarse structural topology.

modules.name: MSAD - Local Distillation
modules.description: Implements local guidance by selecting top-k salient queries and computing high-resolution attention distillation loss focused on these high-impact regions.

modules.name: MSAD - Integration
modules.description: Combines the quantization reconstruction loss with the global and local distillation losses using balancing factors to form the unified MSAD objective.

modules.name: PTQ Calibration Trainer
modules.description: Executes the block-wise post-training calibration loop, optimizing quantization parameters (scales, rotations) using the integrated MSAD loss without retraining model weights.

modules.name: SSAR - Residual Calculator
modules.description: Computes the first-order and second-order residuals between the full-attention and sparse attention outputs to analyze and capture temporal variations in attention errors.

modules.name: SSAR - SVD Stabilizer
modules.description: Applies Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on the second-order residuals to project them onto dominant principal components, extracting temporally stable patterns.

modules.name: SSAR - Inference Engine
modules.description: Implements the inference-time logic for Second-Order Sparse Attention Reparameterization, managing the caching and updating of residuals at specified intervals to approximate full attention.

modules.name: Video Generation Pipeline
modules.description: Wraps the quantized and sparse DiT model with the diffusion sampling loop to perform end-to-end video generation from text prompts.

modules.name: Quality Metric Evaluator
modules.description: Calculates video quality metrics including CLIPSIM, VQA, FlowScore, and relative difference metrics (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) against the full-precision baseline.

modules.name: Efficiency Profiler
modules.description: Measures and reports computational efficiency metrics such as model storage size, GPU memory consumption, DiT inference latency, and end-to-end speedup.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Analyzer
modules.description: Provides frameworks for ablation studies on MSAD and SSAR components, and sensitivity analysis for hyperparameters like pooling stride, salient token count, cache intervals, and attention density.
